effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Afterwards, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) [All Turns] Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.
